chapter: Ellington, singers, the book and closing
title: Wrapping up: Mingus's string quartet
summary: Hentoff has to leave for newspaper strike preparations; Mingus offers his string quartet recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: You're going to hear my string quartet before you go.
How long -- I can't, because I've got to go back. We're preparing for a big strike at the paper, I mean, the newspaper strike.
All right. Or do you have a cassette of it or something?
No, it's not that good. It's just a -- not a real recording, it's just --
Oh, I don't care what the quality of the sound is, if I could have something just to play it with. Yeah, because I want to hear it.
What kind of part does it have, I mean,
This is very good. I'm going to save some of it for myself.
